# observation method

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:observationMethod`](gmeow-observationMethod.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/observationMethod>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)

The method or protocol used to produce the observation. Functional: one method per observation (compound protocols are modelled as a single fused method individual, e.g. 'GPS-RTK survey with ground control'). Distinct from [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md): the method is *how* it was done, the vantage is *who* did it.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) -> [`gmeow:ObservationMethod`](../classes/gmeow-ObservationMethod.md); functional
